# Debugging {#sec-debugging}

*A companion to the debugging clinics in weeks ten and eleven.*

## Draft stub — planned contents
Works through reading a traceback, locating the failing line, forming a hypothesis about the cause, and confirming it with a test or a codelens trace. Uses curated, authored bugs so the failure is guaranteed and pedagogically chosen rather than relying on a live assistant to misbehave. Reused across the two clinic weeks.
:::
